confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Galle and southern Sri Lanka, not checked against live menus or booking pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately confident, since Sri Lankan prices are volatile and alcohol carries high taxes. Accommodation anchors are less certain. July falls in the southwest monsoon period on the south coast, so accommodation is set at shoulder-season levels rather than the peak Dec-Mar rates. Hotel and hostel prices are estimated to include the usual Sri Lankan taxes and service charges. The FX observation is the RBA figure for 15 Oct 2026 as reported in search results, not independently read from the RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: southern Sri Lankan coastal tourist towns (such as Unawatuna and Mirissa), adjusted to Galle's Fort-area pricing and a lower cost base than Colombo. Drink prices are set from the local beer price, with wine priced higher because of import duties on wine.
